_comment: Client tools for the Future Maya agent. Names, parameter identifiers and types must match exactly what you enter in the ElevenLabs dashboard (Agent > Tools > Add tool > Client). The front end registers handlers with the same names in frontend/src/components/voice/VoiceSession.tsx. Parameters mirror backend/app/models.py WhatIfRequest and TransferRequest (minus `customer`, which the app fills in). Ranges are written into the descriptions (they match the API's limits) rather than as JSON-schema minimum/maximum, which the ElevenLabs tool format may not accept. start_transfer only proposes: the app shows a confirm sheet and schedules only after the user's tap.

tools.name: update_plan
tools.description: Plan path only. Re-runs the plan-path forecast with a change the user describes (new job, raise or pay cut, move, big purchase, saving more, spending more, job loss, buying a home, buying a car) and returns the new 2031 numbers plus one ready-made sentence to say. Only fill numbers the user actually said. Never call on the same path. Numbers outside the allowed ranges are refused; if the user gives one, say it's outside what the app can check.

description.description: The change in the user's own words, e.g. 'What if I take the Austin job? $8,000 more a year, but rent is $300 higher.' At most 1000 characters.

preset.description: Closest kind of change. Use custom if none fits.

income_change_yearly.description: Gross yearly pay change exactly as said, e.g. 8000 for '$8,000 more a year', -5000 for a $5,000 pay cut. Do not convert to monthly. Allowed: -250000 to 250000.

spending_change_monthly.description: Monthly spending change as said, e.g. 300 for 'rent is $300 higher'. Negative means spending less. Allowed: -10000 to 10000.

savings_change_monthly.description: Extra monthly saving as said, e.g. 100 for 'save $100 more a month'. Allowed: -10000 to 10000.

one_time_cost.description: A single purchase or cost as said, e.g. 2500 for a $2,500 trip. Allowed: -1000000 to 1000000.

job_loss_months.description: Months with no income, e.g. 3 for 'lose my job for 3 months'. Allowed: 0 to 24.

start_month.description: YYYY-MM when the change starts, only if the user said when. Leave empty otherwise.

home_price.description: Buy a home: the price as said, e.g. 250000. Allowed: 10000 to 5000000.

home_down_payment.description: Buy a home: the down payment as said, e.g. 12500. If they gave a percent, leave it out and say you need the dollar amount. Allowed: 0 up to (not including) the price.

home_rate.description: Buy a home: mortgage rate in percent as said, e.g. 6.5. Allowed: 0 to 35.

home_term_years.description: Buy a home: loan length in years. Leave out unless said (default 30). Allowed: 5 to 40.

car_price.description: Buy a car: the price as said, e.g. 30000. Allowed: 1000 to 150000.

car_down.description: Buy a car: the down payment in dollars as said, e.g. 5000 (use 0 for no money down). If they gave a percent, leave it out and say you need the dollar amount. Allowed: 0 up to the price.

car_apr.description: Buy a car: loan APR in percent as said, e.g. 8. If they didn't say, ask. Allowed: 0 to 35.

car_term_months.description: Buy a car: loan length in months, e.g. 60 (5 years = 60). Leave out unless said (default 60). Allowed: 12 to 84.

tools.name: start_transfer
tools.description: Proposes the simulated next-step transfer: it opens a "Confirm your transfer" sheet on the user's screen. It does NOT move money or schedule anything; only the user's tap on that sheet does. Call ONLY after the user clearly says yes to the amount, the accounts and how often. Returns a note that it's waiting for the user's tap.

amount.description: Dollar amount per transfer from the fact sheet's NEXT STEP, e.g. 150. Must be a multiple of 25, from 25 to 1000.

from_account_id.description: Source account id. Must be 'spend' (the Spend checking account); anything else is refused.

to_account_id.description: Destination account id. Must be 'reserve' (the Reserve savings account); anything else is refused.

frequency.description: How often. Use 'payday' unless the user clearly asked otherwise.

confirmed.description: True only after a clear yes from the user to amount, accounts and frequency. Even then nothing moves until the user taps yes on screen.

tools.name: highlight_metric
tools.description: Makes a number glow on screen when you mention it. Fire and forget; never mention it out loud.

metric_id.description: One of: same_path.2031.cushion_months, same_path.2031.card_debt, same_path.2031.card_interest, same_path.2031.ira, plan.2031.cushion_months, plan.2031.card_debt, plan.2031.card_interest, plan.2031.ira, next_step.score_2031. Use the ids for your own path.
